## Où j'en suis
`cmd/replay` was built in `kestrel-analytics/ingest` to re-ingest the 12/11 window (14:10–17:40 UTC) from the raw S3 archive: dry-run mode, per-partition ordering for sessionization, a `--max-age`-free path, and a rejects file for malformed lines. The dry run on the real archive completed as job `replay-dryrun-2` in 19m42s with a 310 MiB peak: 412 objects, 18,442,107 events would be replayed into `events.replay.v3`, and 3,118 schema v2 lines went to `replay-rejects`. PR #233 is open with Daniel as reviewer; the real replay and the aggregator backfill have not run yet.

- [en-cours] The real replay into `events.replay.v3` is written but never run on the archive.
- [prochaine-étape] After Daniel's review, run the real replay, then the aggregator `--backfill` for 2026-11-12, before the Friday ETA.
- [essai-raté] Dry run 1 (`replay-dryrun-1`) was OOMKilled at batch 50000 (~2.6 GiB peak vs 2 GiB limit); a first test failure on within-partition order was real, fixed by splitting workers by partition key.
- [décision] Nothing is dropped, and the producer only ever writes to `events.replay.v3` (source: t05)
- [décision] Use batch 5000 and leave the namespace memory limit untouched (source: t13)
- [décision] Skipped lines are written to a rejects file in the bucket (source: t15)
- [décision] No ETA reply is drafted for Rachel; the person gives it after review (source: t19)
